requirements.evidence: There is no migration for queues.priority_prefix_map or tickets.issue_date, and the unique index is not swapped (no database/migrations file in the diff). app/Models/Ticket.php has no 'issue_date' => 'date' cast. Map validation and null-normalization exist only in UpdateQueue (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:58-83), not in the model on every save. IssueTicket calls now() twice (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:42 and :53). The factory default 'issue_date' => now()->toDateString() (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:34) ignores an overridden issued_at. There are no docs or CHANGELOG updates. The prefix resolution (app/Models/Queue.php:32-48) and the daily per-prefix sequence that skips malformed codes (app/Models/Ticket.php:53-69) are implemented.

conventions.evidence: No generated migration, though one is required. docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md are not updated. Public methods have no PHPDoc (Ticket::nextCodeWithPriorityAndDate, Queue::prefixForPriority). Indentation is broken at app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:43 and :54, so Pint would fail. There is a redundant same-namespace 'use App\Models\Queue;' at app/Models/Ticket.php:15. On the positive side, the write still goes through the UpdateQueue action, and the Gate::authorize call is kept.

security.evidence: Authorization is unchanged (Gate::forUser($actor)->authorize('update', $queue) in UpdateQueue). The map is validated before assignment in UpdateQueue and is not added to the fillable list. The model-level invariant that the task requires is missing, so any other save path can store an unvalidated map. That has limited impact.

tests.evidence: The diff contains no test file at all. Nothing covers prefixes, the daily restart, malformed codes, map validation, the factory behaviour or the migration.

simplicity.evidence: app/Models/Queue.php:41-47 hard-codes 'N'/'E'/'P' instead of using DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP. Ticket::nextCodeWithPriorityAndDate re-queries the queue with Queue::findOrFail($queueId) (app/Models/Ticket.php:55) even though IssueTicket already holds $lockedQueue. Validation is written inline in the action rather than once in the model. The old Ticket::nextCode is left in place next to the new method.

readability.evidence: Indentation is misaligned at app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:43 and :54. The validation block in UpdateQueue::__invoke is long and nested (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:57-84). The method name nextCodeWithPriorityAndDate is clear.

scope.evidence: All edits touch files listed in the task: IssueTicket, UpdateQueue, Queue, Ticket and TicketFactory. There are no unrelated changes.

issues.explanation: There is no migration adding queues.priority_prefix_map or tickets.issue_date (with backfill and NOT NULL) and none replacing the (queue_id, code) unique index, so the code writes to columns that do not exist and the daily restart would violate the old unique index.
The change ships no tests at all, which breaks the project's mandatory TDD rule.
The model has no validation or empty-map-to-null normalization on save and never throws InvalidArgumentException; validation lives only in UpdateQueue.
There is no 'issue_date' => 'date' cast, so $ticket->issue_date->toDateString() from the contract fails.
The clock is read twice (now() for issue_date and again for issued_at), so a ticket issued at midnight can get a code day and issued_at on different dates.
issue_date always defaults to today even when issued_at is overridden, so factory rows are misaligned and get the wrong unique-index day.
The docs and changelog updates the task requires are missing.
Indentation is broken at lines 43 and 54, so Pint would fail.
The method re-fetches the queue with findOrFail instead of being passed the already locked Queue model.
The default fallback hard-codes letters instead of using DEFAULT_PREFIX_MAP, and no public defaultPrefixFor resolver is provided.
The 'use App\Models\Queue;' import is redundant because the class is in the same namespace.

review.summary: The change adds priority-based prefix resolution, a per-day per-prefix code sequence and map validation inside UpdateQueue. It is missing the migration, the model-level validation and normalization, the issue_date cast, the docs and all tests, and it reads the clock twice during issuance. It cannot work against the current schema and needs substantial rework.
